page_title: WHU 0-2 LIV | West Ham v Liverpool 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+2' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) scores with a brilliant shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Joe Gomez. The score is now 0:2.
90+1' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) sends a cross in and finds Niclas Fullkrug inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool).
88' Here is a change. Freddie Potts is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Tomas Soucek (West Ham).
88' Fine attempt! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
87' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
85' Today's match ends for Milos Kerkez who will be replaced by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool).

84' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is given a second yellow card for his behaviour. He said too much to the referee and Darren England sent him off. One can only wonder what was going on his head. He has weakened his team.
83' A yellow card for bad language! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
83' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Darren England has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
80' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
79' Darren England blows his whistle. Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) commits a foul after dangerous play.
78' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) replaces Callum Wilson.
77' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florian Wirtz leaves the pitch and Curtis Jones (Liverpool) comes on.
75' Darren England blows for a foul after Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
71' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
71' Freddie Potts (West Ham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
70' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Soungoutou Magassa and he is replaced by Luis Guilherme (West Ham).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch for Alexander Isak.
66' Yellow card. Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
66' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation.
65' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
63' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alphonse Areola reads it well and gathers the ball.
63' A pass into the penalty area from Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
62' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
60' 0 - 1 Goal! Cody Gakpo pulls the ball back for Alexander Isak (Liverpool) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
59' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post.
57' Corner kick. Freddie Potts (West Ham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
56' Freddie Potts (West Ham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

56' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and West Ham will have a corner.
55' Freddie Potts (West Ham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
55' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, West Ham are going to take it.
52' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alisson is quickest to intercept the ball.
52' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
50' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Freddie Potts (West Ham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

45+1' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The game is interrupted. Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
43' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

41' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Darren England with no other option than to blow for a foul.
39' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Alphonse Areola is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
38' The referee blows his whistle as Callum Wilson (West Ham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
37' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) is penalised for holding. Darren England signals a set piece.
36' A cross from El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
36' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
33' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
31' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) produces a killer pass onto Cody Gakpo, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
30' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
29' Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul.

28' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
26' Good clearance! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
26' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
25' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
24' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Darren England blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
22' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
21' The ball is crossed into the box and Alexander Isak (Liverpool) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola gets a glove on it to thwart him.
20' Flag goes up against Callum Wilson (West Ham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
20' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) probably handled the ball.
18' Freddie Potts (West Ham) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
18' Callum Wilson (West Ham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. West Ham have a corner.
17' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) sends a wild header high over the bar.
16' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
16' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Liverpool win a corner.
15' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Darren England stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
13' Alisson (Liverpool) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' The game is interrupted now, Alisson (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
11' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alisson is quickest to intercept the ball.
8' Freddie Potts (West Ham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
7' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Now West Ham have a corner.
4' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
2' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
1' Callum Wilson (West Ham) commits a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Darren England.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
